scope: Verified the PDF image-layer rules cited below against the locally supplied ISO_32000-2_sponsored_EC3.txt (ISO 32000-2:2020 with errata collection 3): 8.9.3-8.9.7, Tables 87, 88, 90-92; 7.4.6/Table 11 and 7.4.8/Table 13. Resource budgets were checked against local ADR 0010, not an ISO conformance requirement. JPEG/fax bitstream algorithms are NOT primary-text verified: ITU-T T.81, ISO/IEC 10918, Adobe Technical Note 5116, ITU-T T.4 and T.6 are unavailable locally. Separate Python encoders establish synthetic expectations but cannot exclude a shared reading error. Also verified the PDF wrappers in 7.4.7/Table 12, 7.4.9/Table 87 and embedded-mask precedence in 11.6.4.3; ISO/IEC 14492:2019 (T.88), ISO/IEC 15444-1/-2 and ICC profile semantics remain pending primary-text review.

review.rule: Interleaved unsigned samples are MSB first, 16-bit values are big endian, and each row starts at a byte boundary with padding ignored.
review.evidence: Raw/Flate 1/2/4/8/16-bit vectors compute samples directly.
review.expectation_agreement: Agrees for the exercised rule at the stated sample/metadata boundary.

review.rule: Samples run left to right from the top image row.
review.evidence: Decoded samples preserve source row order; painting transforms remain outside this crate.
review.expectation_agreement: Agrees for the exercised rule at the stated sample/metadata boundary.

review.rule: JPEG 2000 may provide a different precision for each colour component.
review.verdict: implemented at the PDF adapter boundary
review.evidence: jpx-mixed-precision retains 1/3/10-bit ordinary channels without normalization.
review.implementation_agreement: implemented at the PDF adapter boundary
review.expectation_agreement: Agrees for the exercised rule at the stated sample/metadata boundary.

requirements.verdict: ISO sample packing agrees; JPX mixed precision added.

requirements.gaps: Decode mapping, default ranges, clipping, masks and embedded colour interpretation are retained for painting, not rendered by this crate.

review.rule: Image dictionaries must have consistent dimensions, colour space, precision and filter output; image XObjects require Subtype Image.
review.evidence: Added iso-runlength-eight-bit, iso-runlength-one-bit-rejected and iso-xobject-subtype-required.
review.expectation_agreement: Agrees for the exercised rule at the stated sample/metadata boundary.

review.rule: Decode maps sample endpoints linearly per component; descending and out-of-colour-range endpoints are allowed, and Indexed defaults to the full sample integer range.
review.evidence: Explicit arrays are validated and retained; absent arrays stay None so painting must implement Table 88 defaults and output clipping.
review.expectation_agreement: Agrees for the exercised rule at the stated sample/metadata boundary.

review.rule: Interpolate is a rendering hint that a processor may ignore.
review.evidence: The decoder retains the hint; no resampling claim is made.
review.expectation_agreement: Agrees for the exercised rule at the stated sample/metadata boundary.

review.rule: A stencil is one bit with no colour space; Decode 0 1 paints zero and Decode 1 0 paints one.
review.evidence: Stencil kind and inversion metadata preserve the two meanings.
review.expectation_agreement: Agrees for the exercised rule at the stated sample/metadata boundary.

review.rule: An explicit stencil mask overlays the base image unit square and may have different dimensions.
review.evidence: Mask identity is retained without an equal-resolution restriction.
review.expectation_agreement: Agrees for the exercised rule at the stated sample/metadata boundary.

review.rule: Colour-key ranges contain two integer endpoints per component and compare inclusive raw samples before Decode.
review.evidence: Range endpoints and component counts are validated; painting is outside this crate.
review.expectation_agreement: Agrees for the exercised rule at the stated sample/metadata boundary.

review.rule: SMask takes precedence over Mask.
review.evidence: soft-overrides-key retains only the soft-mask identity.
review.expectation_agreement: Agrees for the exercised rule at the stated sample/metadata boundary.

choices: Reject reversed colour-key ranges as malformed rather than treating them as an empty mask; the cited text does not separately specify endpoint ordering.
Preserve Decode metadata without applying the mapping or Table 88 defaults during sample decoding.
decode_xobject is the base-image entry point and requires Subtype Image; the Table 87 thumbnail exception needs a distinct thumbnail caller contract.
requirements.verdict: ISO mismatches fixed at the decoder metadata boundary; painting remains separate.

requirements.gaps: Legacy Flate/LZW boundary search has a sixteen-candidate work cap. Unfiltered resource colour spaces without Length need a resource-aware boundary API. Inline filter repairs require a document diagnostic sink.

review.rule: Inline images use BI/ID/EI, accept the listed abbreviations, and ignore unlisted entries; those abbreviations are not XObject abbreviations.
review.evidence: Added iso-xobject-filter-abbreviation and iso-inline-unknown-entry-ignored.
review.expectation_agreement: Agrees for the exercised rule at the stated sample/metadata boundary.

review.rule: PDF 2.0 Length/L excludes operator-delimiting whitespace; ASCIIHex/ASCII85 boundary sizing skips additional leading whitespace before counting L, while older files may omit L.
review.verdict: fixed for ASCII leading whitespace; remaining lexical BI/ID/EI checks belong to the content parser
review.evidence: iso-inline-ascii-length-whitespace counts three encoded bytes after an extra space and newline.
review.implementation_agreement: fixed for ASCII leading whitespace; remaining lexical BI/ID/EI checks belong to the content parser
review.expectation_agreement: Agrees for the exercised rule at the stated sample/metadata boundary.

review.rule: Direct inline colour spaces are device spaces or limited Indexed with a device base and string lookup; named resource spaces may be any image colour space.
review.evidence: Added direct Lab rejection, resource Lab success, and non-string Indexed lookup rejection.
review.expectation_agreement: Agrees for the exercised rule at the stated sample/metadata boundary.

review.rule: JBIG2Decode, JPXDecode and Crypt are forbidden inline image filters.
review.evidence: Inline entry points reject these filters; capability extensions must preserve this restriction.
review.expectation_agreement: Agrees for the exercised rule at the stated sample/metadata boundary.

choices: Accept lengthless data as legacy input because the standalone boundary API has no PDF version; cap candidate validation at sixteen attempts and reject conflicting long/abbreviated keys.
requirements.repair_hook: When Document::report is available, forward Diagnostics from inline FilterChain decoding and CCITT decode_with_diagnostics; this change retains strict document-image repair behaviour.
requirements.verdict: ISO mismatches fixed; forbidden filters remain rejected, and legacy sizing remains a documented choice.

requirements.gaps: 12-bit precision, arithmetic/lossless/hierarchical coding unsupported; nearest chroma expansion.

review.rule: PDF DCT samples have one, three or four byte-sized colour components.
review.evidence: Supported layouts and eight-bit precision are enforced; broader JPEG processes remain explicit capability gaps.
review.expectation_agreement: Agrees for the exercised PDF-level rule at the stated boundary; the named external format rules remain pending.

review.rule: APP14 overrides the dictionary transform; otherwise default to a transform for three components only, and ignore the option for a single component.
review.evidence: Added ignored invalid integer options for grayscale/APP14 and rejection when an invalid option is effective.
review.expectation_agreement: Agrees for the exercised PDF-level rule at the stated boundary; the named external format rules remain pending.

external_primary_text_review.behaviour: Huffman tables, scan ordering, restart intervals, progressive refinement, IDCT and colour conversion constants.
external_primary_text_review.evidence: Synthetic independently written Python encoder and calculated pixels; no external differential run or externally sourced known-answer data in this change.

external_primary_text_review.behaviour: Exact APP14 marker rules and four-component JPEG conventions.
external_primary_text_review.evidence: Synthetic independently written Python encoder and calculated pixels; no external differential run or externally sourced known-answer data in this change.

choices: Nearest-neighbour chroma expansion and one-level IDCT oracle tolerance are implementation choices, not ISO-verified JPEG accuracy claims.
requirements.verdict: ISO wrapper rules agree after fixes; JPEG/Adobe primary-text review pending.

requirements.gaps: T.6 extension mode unsupported. Damaged-row recovery is available through decode_with_diagnostics; document image decoding remains strict until a document diagnostic sink is public.

review.rule: Decoded fax rows are byte padded; encoded rows normally share a bit stream and can request byte alignment.
review.evidence: Exact odd-width, polarity and alignment vectors exercise row formatting.
review.expectation_agreement: Agrees for the exercised PDF-level rule at the stated boundary; the named external format rules remain pending.

review.rule: Use only the sign of K, apply parameter defaults, accept optional EOL, and let EndOfBlock override Rows.
review.evidence: Added iso-fax-positive-k-equivalence; existing vectors cover EOL, unknown Rows and EndOfBlock precedence.
review.expectation_agreement: Agrees for the exercised PDF-level rule at the stated boundary; the named external format rules remain pending.

review.rule: For nonnegative K with EOL, tolerated damaged rows copy the preceding good row or become white after damage, with EOL resynchronization.
review.evidence: fax-damaged-rows checks strict rejection and two reported substitutions.
review.expectation_agreement: Agrees for the exercised PDF-level rule at the stated boundary; the named external format rules remain pending.

external_primary_text_review.behaviour: Group 3 code tables, one/two-dimensional run coding and RTC bit patterns.
external_primary_text_review.evidence: Synthetic Python fax encoder with directly constructed bitmap expectations; no external differential run or externally sourced known-answer data in this change.

external_primary_text_review.behaviour: Group 4 modes, changing elements, EOFB and extension coding.
external_primary_text_review.evidence: Synthetic Python fax encoder with directly constructed bitmap expectations; no external differential run or externally sourced known-answer data in this change.

choices: Count the damaged-row tolerance across the image; keep the standalone decoder strict and expose substitutions only through decode_with_diagnostics.
requirements.repair_hook: When Document::report is available, forward Diagnostics from inline FilterChain decoding and CCITT decode_with_diagnostics; this change retains strict document-image repair behaviour.
requirements.verdict: ISO parameters and reported substitution agree; fax primary-text review pending.

review.rule: Check pixel, decoded storage and work budgets before the allocation or work they protect.
review.evidence: Budget, truncation and mutation tests cover bounded rejection; this is not an ISO requirement.
review.expectation_agreement: Agrees for the exercised rule at the stated sample/metadata boundary.

requirements.verdict: Project ADR rule agrees; not an ISO conformance verdict.

review.rule: Decode embedded page-1 bitonal data with page-0 segments supplied by the separately decoded JBIG2Globals stream.
review.evidence: PDF vectors exercise black/white polarity, Flate globals and a preceding ASCIIHex filter.
review.expectation_agreement: Agrees for the exercised PDF-level rule at the stated boundary; the named external format rules remain pending.

external_primary_text_review.behaviour: Segment, symbol and arithmetic coding procedures, including polarity of the decoded bitmap.
external_primary_text_review.evidence: Integrated independent Python JBIG2 encoder, direct bitmap expectations and PDF wrappers; no external differential run in this change.

requirements.gaps: JBIG2 coding modes not supported by the integrated decoder remain explicit feature errors.
requirements.verdict: PDF wrapper rules exercised; JBIG2 primary-text review pending.

review.rule: Use a full JPEG 2000 container; dictionary dimensions must match, dictionary ColorSpace overrides container colour and BitsPerComponent is ignored.
review.evidence: PDF fixtures cover container colour/ICC, overriding colour, ignored precision and dimension mismatch.
review.expectation_agreement: Agrees for the exercised PDF-level rule at the stated boundary; the named external format rules remain pending.

review.rule: Without dictionary ColorSpace use the container colour and ignore Decode; JPX components can have independent precision.
review.evidence: Mixed 1/3/10-bit palette output, 16-bit output and ignored cyclic Decode/precision references.
review.expectation_agreement: Agrees for the exercised PDF-level rule at the stated boundary; the named external format rules remain pending.

review.rule: SMaskInData zero ignores alpha; nonzero requires one all-colour opacity channel and excludes SMask; mode two denotes premultiplied colour.
review.evidence: Straight-alpha PDF vectors and adapter-level premultiplied metadata tests pass; decoder cdef type 2 remains unsupported.
review.expectation_agreement: Agrees for the exercised PDF-level rule at the stated boundary; the named external format rules remain pending.

review.rule: An embedded soft mask overrides an explicit or colour-key Mask.
review.evidence: jpx-alpha-overrides-mask retains alpha without applying the overridden colour key.
review.expectation_agreement: Agrees for the exercised PDF-level rule at the stated boundary; the named external format rules remain pending.

review.rule: Enumerated CMYK is supported, CIEJab is excluded, and unsupported embedded colour descriptions fall back by ordinary channel count.
review.evidence: jpx-container-colour-12/18/19 exercise CMYK, retained sYCC with device fallback and rejected CIEJab.
review.expectation_agreement: Agrees for the exercised PDF-level rule at the stated boundary; the named external format rules remain pending.

external_primary_text_review.behaviour: JPEG 2000 bitstream coding, container/palette channel definitions, enumerated colour spaces and profile semantics.
external_primary_text_review.evidence: Integrated independently authored Python JPEG 2000 encoder, direct sample expectations and PDF wrappers; no external differential run in this change.

requirements.gaps: Premultiplied cdef type 2, ignored unsupported container colour/opacity, colour precedence and subsampled reference-grid geometry require decoder/API changes; ICC and sYCC interpretation is retained for painting.
choices: Preserve embedded colour profiles and non-device enumerated spaces for painting; mixed sample precision uses a zero common-precision sentinel with per-component accessors.
requirements.verdict: PDF wrapper and straight alpha exercised; complete premultiplied/container handling blocked by decoder API gaps.
